svg.title: Attrition bias in a panel: 1,000 students shrink to 650
svg.desc: Two grids of 40 icons, each icon equal to 25 students. Wave 1 has 1,000 students: 400 high-stress or at risk of leaving university (coral) and 600 others (teal). Two years later 650 remain: 350 left the panel, 250 of them high-stress or leavers and 100 others; dropouts appear as dashed outlines. The high-stress share falls from 40% to 23%. Message: the retained panel looks healthier even if no one's stress changed, because the most stressed were most likely to leave.

text.tspan: Retention 65% · the loss is not random
The retained panel looks healthier, even if no one's stress changed.
The most stressed students were the most likely to leave.
